name: Retro-Futuristic
traits: streamlined machines with fins, domes and chrome trim
geometric atomic-age forms: boomerangs, starbursts, ovals
pastel and turquoise palettes with warm sunset skies
an optimistic mid-century picture of tomorrow
bestFor: 'the future of your kitchen' style reveals
suits: appliances, gadgets, drinks, travel and smart-home products; optimistic, inventive, upbeat brands
stylePara: Mid-century retro-futurist illustration in motion: a tomorrow imagined around 1958, with streamlined machines that have tail fins, bubble domes, chrome trim and rounded rocket shapes; homes with boomerang tables, starburst clocks and glass walls opening onto upswept towers; characters drawn with clean confident lines and stylised long proportions; flat gouache colour in turquoise, coral, mint, cream and atomic orange, with airbrushed glows only on chrome and sky; soft printed grain and slight colour fade, like a painted magazine spread of the world to come.

rendering.line: clean, confident ink line with tapered ends; machines drawn with ruler-straight edges and perfect ellipses
rendering.shading: flat colour with one painted shadow tone; chrome as hard bands of white and sky colour; soft airbrush only on glows
rendering.colour: turquoise, coral, mint, cream and atomic orange under a warm peach-to-teal sky; the product's green and yellow kept exact and treated as a sleek device colour
rendering.texture: light print grain and paper warmth, faint colour fade; chrome stays crisp
rendering.lighting: bright optimistic daylight or a sunset glow; neon-like halos on domes and dials

motion: Animated on twos with smooth, gliding machine moves and springy character gestures; devices move in clean arcs and slide on rails, dials sweep, lights blink in sequence; nothing is grimy or shaky.
camera: Wide showroom framings with low horizon lines; slow sweeping crane-like pans across the world of tomorrow; graceful push-ins on the gadget; symmetrical compositions for reveals.
avoid: modern glass smartphones and flat-screen interfaces
slogans or lettering on billboards and machines
sheets: Each character in front, three-quarter and side with the stylised long proportions fixed; the place as a wide of the home of tomorrow and a detail of its signature gadget; the product redrawn sleek but with its exact bottle shape and colours, plus one view in the retro machine context.
risk: Seedance pulls the future toward modern sci-fi (dark blue, holograms, glass phones) and renders chrome as photoreal 3D; repeat 'imagined in 1958, flat gouache, painted chrome bands' and name the props (fins, domes, starburst clocks). Billboards and control panels fill with fake lettering, so say 'no words on machines or signs'.

example.prompt: Mid-century retro-futurist illustration still: a woman in her thirties with a dark bun and an orange top, drawn in clean tapered ink lines with stylised long proportions, holds a small green glass bottle with a yellow cap; a sunny kitchen of tomorrow with a bubble-domed appliance, chrome trim, a starburst clock and a glass wall onto upswept towers, a droopy fern on the windowsill; flat gouache turquoise, coral and cream, painted chrome bands, light print grain. Vertical 9:16. No text.
